figures.title: The cost that fell as the work grew - attn_pre_proj
caveats: A median that falls as the token count rises cannot be the hardware; this is what prompted the investigation.
Monotonicity was never an acceptance criterion - the final dataset still has downward steps.

figures.title: Holding the GPU behind the host - attn_pre_proj

steps.name: Holding the GPU behind the host

caveats: This is a diagnostic, not an iteration: 4,800 rows, tokens >=1,024 only, the old single-column timer plus one opt-in backlog knob.
One change that touches no kernel removes the dip at every op and TP - that is the evidence the event pairs had been timing the host.
The two passes differ in clock state as well as queue state (~2.0 GHz idle-start vs ~2.4 GHz after the spin).

figures.title: The RoPE kernel that was not RoPE - attn_rope

steps.name: Holding the GPU behind the host
Timing the GPU, not the host

caveats: Different computation, not a timing fix: the fallback was 13 launch-bound kernels rotating only the first 64 columns of head 0.
The two jobs also differ in repetitions, timer and grid, so this ratio mixes the kernel change with the timing change.
attn_pre_proj and attn_post_proj agree within 1.2 % across the same pair, which is what makes them controls.

figures.title: Patterns inside the repetitions - attn_pre_proj

steps.name: Timing the GPU, not the host

caveats: x is 1-based here. The investigation documents count the same positions from 0, which is why the spike is called 'run 11' there.
Two separate defects: a within-block drift (the backlog spin let the clock domains idle) and a fixed-position bump (a queue barrier).
Fixing them changed the medians by at most 0.2 % - the backlog change did that, not these.

Scopes below ~10 us sit inside the instrument's few-microsecond floor.

figures.title: How the data changed - attn_pre_proj, TP 1

steps.name: Timing the GPU, not the host

caveats: The first three curves measure the host's launch span, the last four measure device time. Below the crossover they differ because of what is being measured, not because the hardware changed.
The diagnostic (job 21356) is not shown: different grid and timer. The spike re-run is not shown: same protocol as the first re-collection, it would overlap exactly.
